content.short: Coinmerce Capital offers managed crypto investment products, curating vaults on Hyperliquid.
content.description: Coinmerce Capital provides managed investment products for crypto, serving mainly a European retail and wealth client base, and curates vaults on Hyperliquid. Regulated European brokers taking on curator roles is a recent development and brings a different compliance posture to a role that began with crypto-native funds.
content.meta: Managed crypto investment products from a European broker, extended into Hyperliquid vault curation.
